newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers flat ahead of Chinese New Year.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers flat ahead of Chinese New Year.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices were flat on Tuesday ahead of the Chinese Lunar New Year holiday, traders said.
Although demand did go up before the holiday which starts February 7, not many parties were willing to accept firm prices, they added.
"The market was very quiet today," said one trader. "But 380-cst could go down to $96.50 per tonne after the Chinese New Year."
Independents quoted 380-cst at $98 and 180-cst at $104 . MDO and gas oil were quoted at $90 and $197-$201 respectively.
